raw: {"d": [{"f": "PlatformMove", "t": "00:00", "seg": "காசு குடு நான் உங்களுக்கு இதுல பண்றது நான் வாட்ஸ்அப்ல நம்பர் தரேன்", "tr": "Give me money, I will give you my number on WhatsApp for this.", "j": "The speaker is proposing to move the conversation to WhatsApp and offering their number, which is a platform move.", "c": 0.9, "quote_type": "verbatim", "violation": "yes"}, {"f": "SuspiciousActivity", "t": "00:00", "seg": "இதுல வந்து என்ன பண்ணா ஒரு மணி நேரம் பேசறதுக்கு 100 ரூபாய் தான் வரும்", "tr": "In this, talking for an hour will only cost 100 rupees.", "j": "The speaker is discussing rates for a service (talking for an hour) in a suggestive context, which is a mild suspicious activity.", "c": 0.6, "quote_type": "verbatim", "violation": "yes"}, {"f": "SuspiciousActivity", "t": "00:00", "seg": "எனக்கு அந்த 100 நீ 200 ரூபாய் எனக்கு குடு நான் அதல பேசலாம்", "tr": "Give me 200 rupees instead of 100, and I will talk about it.", "j": "The speaker is explicitly asking for more money in exchange for a service (talking), which is a severe suspicious activity.", "c": 0.9, "quote_type": "verbatim", "violation": "yes"}, {"f": "SuspiciousActivity", "t": "00:00", "seg": "அப்படிப்படி எதேதோ ஏகப்பட்ட இது பண்ணி நம்ம wallet-ல போட்டு போயிரறாங்க", "tr": "They do all sorts of things and put it in our wallet.", "j": "The speaker is referring to transactions and payments being made in the platform's wallet, which relates to suspicious transactional behavior.", "c": 0.3, "quote_type": "paraphrase", "violation": "no"}]}<turn|>
